title: Roadster | The Last Best Driver's Car
summary:
Roadster is a true pilot's car: active aerodynamics, a multi-mode suction system & cold-gas thrusters

Reserve Roadster - https://www.tesla.com/roadster

EXTERIOR:
– Concealed headlights, full-length taillight & flush-mounted surfaces for a minimalist, highly technical form

– Super light wheels w/ thin spokes that reinforce structural strength when earthbound

– Ano White paint brings an aerospace-derived finish w/ UV & cryogenic protection, electrostatic dissipation & corrosion resistance

– Gold Glazed tinted glass mimicking the copper coating of spacesuit visors, w/ subtle titanium accents


INTERIOR:
– Ultrawhite interior w/ gray microsuede detailing & seat bolsters for added grip

– Manual controls & a fixed seat position reduce overall vehicle mass

– Lightweight, high-strength materials throughout, including magnesium, titanium & carbon fiber help reduce it further

This allows Roadster to respond to driver inputs almost instantly


BEYOND THE LIMIT OF PHYSICS:
– Multi-mode fan & ground sealing system pulls air from beneath the vehicle, generating enough suction to hold it upside down while stationary

– Powered fans & active wings maximize traction and cornering speeds in all conditions, achieving massive downforce at zero speed

– Advanced cold-gas thrusters w/ all-electric actuators make micro adjustments within a fraction of a second to stabilize the vehicle in flight

title: Dexterity Explained | How Dexterity Expands Automation
summary:
Dexterity Explained | How Dexterity Expands Automation

In Part 2 of Dexterity Explained, we look at how different levels of dexterity can unlock different kinds of automation.

Not every task requires the same level of dexterity. At Sanctuary AI, we think about dexterity as a gradient—from vacuum and parallel grippers to highly dexterous robotic hands. The right solution depends on the task.

For our robotic hands, the goal is clear: human-level capability, industrial reliability, and performance that can hold up in real-world environments.

Learn more about our dexterous solutions: https://sanctuary.ai/solutions/
